title: Distributed BenchWatch: p95/p99 quantile matrix and regression detection per route/model/region
creator: Asha Patel
description: Add a distributed benchmarking and visualization workbench (BenchWatch) that produces a p95/p99 latency matrix and automated regression detection sliced by route, model variant, and region. This ticket wires up the load harness to emit percentile summaries and a new Grafana surface that teams can use to diagnose tail regressions and tokens/sec trade-offs at a glance. The goal is to catch and triage sub-10% and larger regressions during model rollouts and infra kernel changes before they impact production SLIs.
acceptance_criteria: Load harness emits per-request summaries and aggregated p95 and p99 per route/model/region at 1m and 5m rollups
New BenchWatch Grafana dashboard shows a matrix view with routes on rows, model variants as columns, and region facets that can be toggled
Automated regression detection flags when p95 or p99 increases by more than 10% relative to baseline over a 1h sliding window and creates a Linked Linear ticket with contextual traces
BenchWatch supports synthetic profiles: short-context burst, long-context steady state, and KV-cache-warm replay
Observed tokens/sec profiles are correlated and displayed alongside quantile plots for capacity planning
Documentation/Runbook for interpreting BenchWatch signals, triage playbook, and how to add new routes/models is published
tasks: Instrument load harness to emit percentile histograms and per-route/model/region tags (ENG infra PR #3478)
Add a streaming aggregator service to roll up histograms into p95/p99 at 1m/5m (workbench-aggregator service)
Design Grafana BenchWatch matrix panels and snapshot templates (dashboard JSON + variables)
Hook regression-detector Lambda to aggregator output and wire to Linear API for auto-creation of regression tickets
Create synthetic load profiles (short/long/kv-warm) and add them to the bench CI
Run ingestion performance tests to ensure aggregator adds <5% overhead to production telemetry pipeline
Write docs and triage runbook and add Console links from rollout pages
progress_updates: 2026-03-01 - Spike completed: validated histogram-based p99 calculation using HdrHistogram in the load harness. Prototype script attached to PR #3467.
2026-03-04 - Instrumentation merged: harness now emits route/model/region tags and histogram buckets. Observed emission overhead ~1.8% in CI microbench.
2026-03-06 - Aggregator prototype: streaming join job computes p50/p95/p99 at 1m/5m; memory footprint within budget for current burst profiles.
2026-03-09 - Dashboard mockups reviewed with PM and Design. Feedback: make region toggles multi-select and add tokens/sec sparkline per cell. Design approved pending minor layout tweaks.

2026-03-12 - Regression detector POC: simple sliding-window comparator created. Tuned threshold to 10% p95 increase + min-requests guard (>= 200 in window). Working on noise filtering using baseline decay.
2026-03-12 - Blocker: need improved route canonicalization for internal routes to avoid duplicate rows in matrix (ENG-27105 created as follow-up).
risks: Telemetry cardinality explosion if route/model tags are too fine-grained — will enforce canonical naming and sampling for low-volume routes
False positives in regression detector during noisy deployment windows — mitigated by min-requests and using both p95 and p99 signals
Aggregator cost: streaming joins at high QPS could increase infra spend — we will limit retention for high-cardinality slices and provide rollup tiers
KV-cache warming interplay: long-context profiles can hide regressions in cold-cache requests; synthetic KV-warm profiles required to surface those
rollout_plan: Stage 1: merge harness changes and aggregator behind feature flag for internal pilot. Stage 2: onboard 5 high-traffic routes and two model variants in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Stage 3: expand to all routes and enable automated ticketing. Monitor cost and noise for two weeks before enabling for Dedicated customers.
owner_notes: Priority is to get high-signal dashboards for the most used endpoints (chat.generate and embeddings.batch). Keep aggregator lightweight — prefer approximate percentiles (HDR) over full histograms if resource constrained. Follow up with Design to add colorblind-friendly palettes for heatmap cells.
qa_plan: Run bench CI with synthetic profiles and assert p95/p99 are stable within expected variance
Introduce a controlled regression (inject 20% latency increase in model variant) and confirm detector creates a Linear ticket
Verify dashboard toggles correctly between regions and that tokens/sec correlation shows expected step changes
Load test aggregator to twice current peak QPS and measure CPU/memory under 10% degradation threshold
